name: Planar Orc
body:
Note Generally more powerful than their Material Plane counterparts, this humanoid variant are more likely be encountered as NPCs but may occasionally be allowed as player characters for high-powered campaigns.

Like planar goblins, most orcs in the Outer Planes exist merely to feed the hordes in the endless fiendish wars. They are larger and meaner than the orcs of the Material Plane.

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +4 Str, +2 Con, –2 Int, –2 Wis, –2 Cha. This trait alters ability scores.
Languages You begin play speaking Abyssal and Orc. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Common, Dwarven, Giant, Gnoll, Goblin, and Infernal. This trait alters languages.
Powerful Build Your physical stature allows you to function in many ways as if you were one size category larger. Whenever you are subject to a size modifier or special size modifier for a Combat Maneuver Bonus or Combat Maneuver Defense (such as during grapple checks, bull rush attempts, and trip attempts), you are treated as one size larger if doing so is advantageous to you. You are also considered to be one size larger when determining the damage of your unarmed strikes, and when determining whether a creature’s special attacks based on size (such as grab or swallow whole) can affect you. You can use weapons designed for a creature one size larger without penalty. However, your space and reach remain those of a creature of your actual size. The benefts of this ancestry trait stack with the effects of powers, abilities, and spells that change your size category.

Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum
